legacy_kinds.note: H3b2b0 remains an honest pure-semantic kernel; no old value becomes authority by reinterpretation.

optional_payload_extension.compatibility: pre-release v0 append-only optional extension: an empty vector is omitted, so every frozen H3b2b1 payload byte remains valid; when non-empty the field is present exactly once in the trailing position
optional_payload_extension.authority_boundary: future target candidate registration only; the existing active-provider kind-9 registration is not reinterpreted

canonical_hash.framing: for prefix, domain, and payload in order: u32 big-endian byte length followed by exact bytes

authenticated_signer_commitment.source: the AppHash-authenticated validator lifecycle effective for the parent state; local configuration, transaction envelope signer, event, or execution ID is not authority
authenticated_signer_commitment.framing: prefix bytes without a length, then for the domain and each part in order: u64 big-endian byte length followed by exact bytes

parts.name: authorized_signers_hash_hex
parts.type: 64-byte canonical lowercase ASCII hex, not decoded Hash32 bytes

authenticated_signer_commitment.block_rule: one immutable commitment is privately constructed for the whole block; switching signer or policy between operations rejects

decision_preimage.normalization: clear both nullifier arrays and zero exactly the operation-kind-specific derived decision fields before canonical JSON re-encode
decision_preimage.signer_substitution: another operator, signer ID, signer key/policy commitment, or same-block signer switch changes the preimage and every derived decision ID and is rejected by production admission

operation_extension.strict_pop: exact CEV0 ValidatorKeyProofOfPossessionV0 verified by production StrictEd25519Verifier and bound to authenticated genesis hash, chain ID, exact successor target epoch, validator ID, consensus key, and registration nonce
operation_extension.changed_key_predecessor: an old-set validator changing key supplies previous_registration_nonce equal to the exact active validator-registration history max_registration_nonce and predecessor_history_head_hex equal to its exact non-revoked history_head_hex; the new nonce is strictly greater
operation_extension.new_validator_predecessor: a validator absent from the old set supplies null previous_registration_nonce and the all-zero predecessor_history_head_hex
operation_extension.unchanged_key: reject; an old-set validator carrying the same key uses the proof-free canonical candidate path instead
operation_extension.persistence: writes only the trailing kind-16 future_candidate_registrations companion; it neither creates nor rewrites a kind-9 active-provider fact

payload.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON produced with the exact field order below, no insignificant whitespace, no unknown fields, and byte-identical re-encode; only the final future_candidate_registrations field is omitted when empty
payload.optional_trailing_field_rule: future_candidate_registrations is absent if and only if empty; when present it is a non-empty array in the exact final position, so payloads omitting the empty extension retain their original canonical bytes
payload.genesis_binding: (revision == 1) if and only if (last_target_height == 0); all non-genesis successors have revision > 1 and last_target_height > 0
payload.record_order: strictly increasing and unique by canonical key
payload.integer_policy: u64 values are unquoted canonical decimal JSON integers over the full 0..2^64-1 range; independent consumers parse them losslessly and reject floats, exponents, signs, leading zeros, overflow, and any byte-changing reformat; u128 business quantities remain canonical decimal strings parsed by BigInt
payload.reservation_record: funded-unused reservation includes reserved_units as a canonical decimal u128 string and requires reserved_units > 0
payload.consumer_key_record: each key retains sorted unique nonce_watermarks keyed by provider_id_hex; every watermark binds max_accepted_nonce to the exact kind-3 logical key so a private key prune can delete the complete authenticated nonce set and commit its summary
payload.active_certificate_record: the exact field order is certificate_id_hex, consumer_id_hex, consumer_key_id_hex, provider_id_hex, task_id_hex, meter_id_hex, meter_version, settlement_commitment_hex, settlement_finalized_height, consumed_units, evidence_root_hex, relationship_class, relationship_key_hex, provider_consensus_key_hex, provider_registration_nonce, provider_proof_digest_hex, provider_registration_decision_id_hex, provider_registration_height, provider_registration_history_head_hex, acceptance_decision_id_hex, funding_decision_id_hex, meter_decision_id_hex, evidence_decision_id_hex, accepted_height, finalized_epoch, tuple_key_hex, prunable_after_height, lifecycle, lifecycle_effective_height, lifecycle_decision_id_hex, semantic_keys; every companion field is re-derived from the authenticated certificate/key/provider/meter/settlement/evidence/relationship/lifecycle projection
payload.finalized_governance_record: the exact field order is target_epoch, phase, proposal_decision_id_hex, proposed_height, decision_id_hex, approval_height, parameters_hash_hex, activation_height; phase/hash/activation and proposal provenance must equal the consumed pending companion and exact kind-15 fact, with 0 < proposed_height < approval_height < activation_height
payload.validator_history_record: the exact field order is validator_id_hex, history_head_hex, max_registration_nonce, consensus_key_hex, current_proof_digest_hex, previous_history_head_hex, registration_decision_id_hex, registration_height, retired_key_count, revoked_at_height, revocation_decision_id_hex; retired consensus-key identities remain permanently committed by family-13 nullifiers instead of an unbounded JSON vector

future_candidate_record.proof: exact CEV0 ValidatorKeyProofOfPossessionV0 verified by production StrictEd25519Verifier
future_candidate_record.changed_key_predecessor: exact non-revoked active history max_registration_nonce and history_head_hex, with a strictly larger new nonce
future_candidate_record.rejections: same-key old validator, reused key, stale epoch, noncanonical or invalid proof, or substituted predecessor, decision, digest, or registration height

payload.nested_canonicality: every nested object is exact-order and deny-unknown; the four usage arrays share one aggregate cap, nonce watermarks have per-key and aggregate caps, and the total cap counts nested nonce watermarks

successor_contract.source: kind 16 is read from the exact manifest-authenticated source projection at source_version/source_root
successor_contract.active_window: target height is within the authenticated active epoch and no later than checkpoint_height - snapshot_lead_blocks
successor_contract.operation_height: every operation target_height equals the authenticated target height
successor_contract.revision: every operation expected_state_revision equals the current overlay revision; the sealed authority envelope and payload use exactly source revision + 1
successor_contract.nullifier: each insertion consumes the preceding root/count and produces the next root/count in operation order
successor_contract.overlay: all operation reads observe the same ordered in-block overlay; exactly one successor kind-16 write is emitted
successor_contract.manifest: all semantic entry writes, private prune deletes, the kind-16 successor, and the unique target-height manifest are one JMT version/root
successor_contract.failure: any rejected operation produces zero writes, no success receipt, and leaves source head/root/manifest/nullifier unchanged
successor_contract.output_boundary: application-write authority only; no candidate, B2-G, handoff, activation, or Core epoch-transition capability

shared_operation_sequences.source_export_rule: sorted unique registry retains every exact Rust export byte, including whitespace; Node rehashes raw_json_hex, exact-parses the scope-specific source export, and every sequence references the matching digest

business_intent_normalization.decision_rule: replace every operation-kind decision binding with exactly 32 zero bytes before canonical JSON hashing

semantic_intent.integer_rule: u64/u128 facts are canonical decimal strings; u32 and u8 wire discriminants are JSON numbers; governance approved is boolean
semantic_intent.normalization_rule: Node and Rust exact-decode each nondelete value through the sole semantic envelope/payload layouts, rederive the raw identity and logical key, omit envelope revision and only the explicitly target-bound semantic heights, and for validator PoP retain schema/genesis/chain/validator/key/nonce while omitting target_epoch and signature; delete binds kind/key/action with null identity/fact, unknown nondelete kinds fail closed, and volatile sparse-Merkle proofs are never part of lineage

business_intent_normalization.omission_boundary: only the three named body fields, envelope revision, target-bound semantic heights, validator-PoP target_epoch/signature, and volatile sparse-Merkle proofs are omitted from lineage/base-positive hashing; exact semantic identity/key/content, production operation bytes, target context, decision preimage, semantic validation, and subjects remain unchanged

shared_operation_sequences.active_genesis: exact validator-lifecycle, genesis PocoAuthorityConfig, active-parameter raw bytes/hash, and every remaining genesis AppHash leaf needed to reconstruct version zero; each named physical key/value must appear byte-for-byte in version-zero history, other_apphash_writes are strictly sorted unique and disjoint from named records, later authenticated history may supersede dynamic PoCO genesis leaves, and no synthetic parameter leaf is permitted when the production store embeds parameters in another authenticated object
shared_operation_sequences.scope_rule: full_application_store binds the same ordered signed transactions through independent ProcessProposal and FinalizeBlock executions plus SQLite commit/restart, V3/V4 restore, and both durable failpoint outcomes; isolated_prune_transition_kernel is explicitly non-production evidence gated by the named activation prerequisite
shared_operation_sequences.semantic_delete_rule: Node permits null semantic successors only for private prune_* operations or for release_settlement deleting exactly one kind-6 logical key re-derived from the same certificate ID; Rust production evidence must additionally prove every exact source fact, permanent nullifier, and complete authorized delete set
shared_operation_sequences.negative_rule: each required negative is a state_dependent_same_subject_replay tied to one successful same-kind business-intent digest or an exact Rust isolated-source lineage; proof-stage replay additionally requires that exact family/subject/key to be occupied in the current authenticated nullifier set and the rejected proof source root to differ from the current authority root; Rust exports an actual stable classifier result and nonzero error-chain digest, while rejected ProcessProposal never invokes FinalizeBlock
shared_operation_sequences.independence: Node independently exact-decodes raw JSON and CEV0, derives decision IDs and subjects, verifies every sparse proof against the authenticated initial/sequential root, recomputes operation/mutation/entry roots and manifests, validates persistence fingerprints, and provides an independent check-final after authoring metadata is stripped
shared_operation_sequences.side_fact_rule: status strings, normalized summaries, telemetry IDs, expected-error echoes, and caller context/proofs are never completion or application authority

operation_sequence_authoring.completion_authority: there is no status field: a step is complete only when its exact fixed Rust event validates source export/request digests, scope, context, source and target heads, ordered raw operations/IDs/root, canonical mutations/root, full target projection/manifest, authority/nullifier successor, persistence evidence, and next production context
operation_sequence_authoring.root_discipline: Node never invents a JMT root: every source and target root is imported from exact retained Rust evidence, while Node independently rehashes all content committed by that root
operation_sequence_authoring.independent_node_work: Node derives every operation-local decision ID and proof plan, enforces sorted unique semantic/proof arrays, checks all absence proofs against one initial root and insertions sequentially, and recomputes operation/mutation/entry roots plus the exact 47-byte manifest
operation_sequence_authoring.partial_rule: check reports partial=true whenever any required automaton block or required negative is absent or any present record awaits its fixed Rust event; within each sequence no later positive step may be appended until the current event is fully revalidated
operation_sequence_authoring.finalization_rule: finalize strips private authoring metadata only after all nine exact automata and actual negatives validate; check-final reconstructs source/nullifier/decision/proof/root/scope/subject continuity from retained raw source exports and finalized raw records
operation_sequence_authoring.scaffold_rule: scaffold-required requires one real full-store source and four scoped isolated-source exports and emits all nine complete next-block field-order skeletons with exact source digests; every marker is non-authorizing and derive rejects it
operation_sequence_authoring.self_test_rule: self-test executes a valid success and actual negative merge, finalizes and independently check-finals it, and proves rejection of status/root/mutation/manifest/source/scope/context/sort/type/signature/persistence/classifier/subject/proof tampering; missing or unknown commands exit nonzero

nullifier_accumulator.path_order: least-significant bit first; level 0 is bit 0 of key[31], level 255 is bit 7 of key[0]
nullifier_accumulator.default_hashes: default[0] is the empty-leaf hash; default[level+1] is the level-bound node hash of default[level] with itself
nullifier_accumulator.occupied_leaf: domain hash of schema_version:u16 followed by the exact derived key
nullifier_accumulator.root_count_binding: count is u64 and checked-adds one before the 256-level proof walk; count zero iff root is the frozen empty root
nullifier_accumulator.non_membership: proof key equals the independently derived family key and empty-leaf reconstruction equals the authenticated source root

certificate_acceptance: chain, genesis, protocol profile, and active parameter equality
active consumer key and strict nonce watermark
active provider kind-9 registration with exact provider identity and matching registration-history companion
certificate, tuple, decision, and nullifier non-membership
meter task/output/version and per-certificate plus rolling caps
pre-existing finalized funded-unused settlement with matching commitment, decision, and reserved_units exactly equal to certificate consumed_units
atomic certificate, nonce, tuple, settlement, measurement, lifecycle, authority, nullifier, and manifest writes
application_rules.consumer_key_authority: authorize and revoke are target-height-bound exact kind-2 transitions; each derived decision consumes a fresh family-9 consumer_key_decision proof, first authorization additionally inserts family-10 consumer_key_identity, and every accepted nonce updates the key companion watermark; wrong-family, wrong-proof, identity reuse, or subject substitution rejects
application_rules.funding_subject: fund_settlement requires exactly one canonical family-1 certificate non-membership proof for certificate_id before creating the funded-unused reservation; release or terminal prune permanently occupies that subject so refund after deletion cannot recreate it
application_rules.release_tombstone: release_settlement privately deletes exactly the funded-unused kind-6 leaf and atomically inserts canonical family-1 certificate plus family-3 release-decision nullifiers in family order; missing, substituted, stale, or replayed proof produces zero writes

cross_meter_usage.rule: all three checked-u128 aggregates span every meter definition, so splitting work across meters cannot reset an active-parameter cap

application_rules.tuple_authority: the sole kind-4 exact decoder retains certificate_id and accepted_height; both must equal the accepted certificate and authenticated target height
application_rules.projection_integrity: startup, migration, V3/V4 restore, source overlay construction, and SQLite precommit reject authority/semantic drift across meter, reservation/settlement, active certificate exact subject/key/provider/meter/units/evidence/relationship/tuple/lifecycle fields, challenge/lifecycle, validator current key/proof/registration height/retired count versus kind-9, and governance phase/kind-15 companions before writes
application_rules.challenge_governance_registration: decision IDs are role/domain/subject/payload/height bound and at-most-once; validator rotation additionally binds the exact predecessor nonce and history head
application_rules.future_candidate_registration: register_future_candidate is an append-only kind-16-only operation for exact active_epoch + 1; it admits zero semantic changes and zero caller non-membership checks, strictly verifies the exact PoP, consumes fresh family-8 decision and family-13 key nullifiers, rejects an unchanged old key, and requires either the exact active predecessor nonce/head for an old-set key change or null/all-zero predecessor authority for a new validator
application_rules.governance_scope: propose_governance and approve_governance are distinct target-height-bound operations; approval consumes the exact authenticated proposal, requires a later height before activation, and both pending and finalized companions are kind-15 projection-checked

pruning.entry: crate-private prune planner only; generic semantic delete remains rejected
pruning.eligibility: all records are terminal, no pending challenge, funded-unused reservation, active certificate, or retained rolling-usage reference remains, and authenticated target height is strictly greater than the checked retention boundary
pruning.certificate: prune_expired_certificate deletes exactly the authority-retained certificate semantic-key set, requires consumed settlement and lifecycle equality, inserts family-1 certificate plus family-2 tuple nullifiers, then removes the authority companion in the same transition
pruning.consumer_key: prune_revoked_consumer_key requires a revoked key and no active certificate reference, deletes exactly kind 2 plus every kind-3 entry named by its nonce_watermarks, inserts the family-11 canonical nonce summary, and removes the key companion; family-9 decisions and family-10 identity were already inserted before prune
pruning.meter: prune_retired_meter requires the strict maximum of protocol and meter retention boundaries, no active certificate reference, and no retained rolling usage; it deletes exactly the matching kind-5 entry and removes the policy companion; family-12 meter identity was inserted at definition
pruning.validator: prune_revoked_validator_history requires the strict protocol retention boundary and no active provider certificate reference; it deletes exactly the matching kind-9 entry and removes the history companion; family-13 active/retired consensus keys and family-14 validator identity remain permanent
pruning.atomicity: every nullifier newly required by the prune is inserted before the exact rich record group is deleted, within the same overlay/JMT/manifest transition
pruning.failure: missing/substituted nullifier, double prune, active reference, count exhaustion, or partial delete rejects the entire block transition

hard_bounds.ordering: source projection plus operation count/bytes are checked with checked arithmetic before operation decode or overlay clone; operation-internal semantic/nullifier counts are checked before semantic planning, while exact nullifier shape validation necessarily decodes each bounded 8,230-byte proof

additional_bounds.retired_registration_keys: represented only by checked retired_key_count; every concrete retired key remains permanently protected by its family-13 nullifier
